name: Orrur Quilla
keeps: the crossing, and the six months between
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: Recited the Lord’s Prayer perfectly on the gallows, which was held to be impossible for a witch.
text: Orrur quilla of the quiet lamp, carries between for the 9th tranche, doors 77 to 85. Keeps the crossing, and the six months between. Reads Rev. George Burroughs.
